en_title: EA Brings Every Ultima and Wing Commander Game to Steam and GOG with Quality-of-Life Updates
cn_title: EA将全部《Ultima》和《Wing Commander》游戏带到Steam及GOG，并推出便利性更新
opus_summary: EA将25款经典游戏带至Steam，其中包括6款《Wing Commander》游戏和《Road Rash》的7款周年纪念版，以及《Ultima》全系列角色扮演游戏等18款再版游戏。再版游戏售价各4.99美元(约合人民币33元)，周年纪念版各9.99美元(约合人民币67元)，部分现有玩家可免费升级。

paragraphs.en: Electronic Arts is bringing 25 classic games from its library to Steam today, including seven Anniversary Editions for six Wing Commander games as well as Road Rash. The rest of the re-releases include every Ultima RPG, both Crusader games, Strike Commander, and Theme Hospital. The 18 re-releases are $4.99 each, while the quality-of-life-updated Anniversary Editions cost $9.99 each.
paragraphs.cn: EA今天将旗下25款经典游戏带到Steam，其中包括六款《Wing Commander》游戏和《Road Rash》的七个周年纪念版。其余重新发行的游戏包括全部《Ultima》角色扮演游戏、两款《Crusader》游戏、《Strike Commander》和《Theme Hospital》。这18款重新发行的游戏售价均为4.99美元，而经过便利性更新的周年纪念版售价均为9.99美元。

paragraphs.en: Regarding those quality-of-life updates, EA says that means that these refreshed versions "support modern systems, controls, improve performance and make the titles more approachable without compromising their authenticity." Regarding Wing Commander specifically, which is perhaps best remembered for its many full-motion video (FMV) cutscenes starring Mark Hamill, the companys says, "For each restored Wing Commander title, these improvements were made possible by the dedicated community, who were open and eager to collaborate with the passionate team at EA to incorporate their mods into the official releases. This launch is a celebration of the community’s commitment to the franchise, which is why anyone who already owns a digital copy of the Wing Commander titles on GOG or the EA App will automatically receive the Anniversary Edition upgrade for free on their respective digital platform."
paragraphs.cn: 关于这些便利性更新，EA表示，这意味着这些焕新版本「支持现代系统和操控方式、改善性能，让这些游戏更容易上手，同时不损害其原汁原味的体验」。具体谈到《Wing Commander》时，这家公司表示：「每款修复后的《Wing Commander》作品中的这些改进，都要归功于尽心尽力的社区，他们乐于并热切地与EA充满热情的团队合作，将他们的模组纳入官方发行版本。此次发布是对社区为该系列付出的一次庆祝，因此，任何已经在GOG或EA App上拥有《Wing Commander》游戏数字版的玩家，都将在各自的数字平台上自动免费获得周年纪念版升级。」《Wing Commander》或许最为人熟知的是其中大量由马克·哈米尔出演的全动态影像（FMV）过场动画。

paragraphs.en: For each of the Anniversary Editions, including my personal favorite, Road Rash (check out the trailer above), EA says, "The Anniversary Editions have been a labor of love, inspired by the discovery of a physical media vault containing thousands of Betacam, VHS, and D1 tapes alongside other media assets. The digitization process recovered the supposedly lost Master FMV sequences for these seven legendary titles, which were meticulously re-edited to restore the over 1,500 cinematic scenes across these games."
paragraphs.cn: 对于每一款周年纪念版，包括我个人最喜欢的《Road Rash》（请看上方预告片），EA表示：「周年纪念版是倾注心血的成果，其灵感源于发现了一座实体媒介档案库，里面除了其他媒体素材外，还存有数千盘Betacam、VHS和D1磁带。数字化过程中找回了这七款传奇作品中据信已遗失的FMV母版片段，这些片段经过精心重新剪辑，复原了这些游戏中的1500多个电影场景。」

paragraphs.en: The Ultima series, meanwhile, was the brainchild of legendary RPG designer Richard "Lord British" Garriott, who went on to build a castle for a house and later become one of the first private citizens to go into outer space. You can hear about those stories and more on my old IGN Unfiltered interview with him from 2017.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，《Ultima》系列出自传奇角色扮演游戏设计师Richard「Lord British」Garriott之手。他后来建造了一座城堡作为住宅，之后又成为首批进入外太空的普通公民之一。你可以在我2017年对他进行的一期《IGN Unfiltered》旧访谈中听到这些故事及更多内容。
